top_signals.title: RBA Downplays Risks From Bathla Collapse to Stability
top_signals.summary: Australia’s central bank has downplayed concerns about the recent collapse of a large property developer, arguing that the company and its lenders in the private credit sector do not represent a system-wide financial stability risk.

top_signals.title: RBI’s Short Dollar Book Exceeds $200 Billion on Forex Plan
top_signals.summary: The Reserve Bank of India’s net short dollar book rose past $200 billion for the first time, reflecting surging future repayment obligations from a dollar diaspora program to support the rupee.

top_signals.title: Trump administration starts sending $500 Obamacare refund checks — who stands to benefit
top_signals.summary: The refunds come after millions of people lost premium subsidies for their health insurance and right before the midterm elections.

top_signals.title: Takaichi to focus on economic growth and better future in policy speech
top_signals.summary: The prime minister will say her administration will draw up a five-year plan for Japan's growth strategy, outlining a path for domestic investment.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Nidec shares sink after auditor withholds opinion on results
top_signals.summary: Thursday's stock decline marks its worst intraday drop since September 2025.
